subject: MAP: acceptance tolerances, exit gates & decision RACI for Novus Health pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alan Jacobs <alan.jacobs@novushealth.com>, Priya Reddy <ops@novushealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + acceptance tolerances for the pilot (first pass)

Hi Alan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Attached is a first-draft mutual action plan that converts the high-level success criteria we discussed into concrete acceptance tests, exit gates, and owner-level responsibilities. High-level notes:

- Exit gate philosophy: allow go/no-go at two checkpoints — "Validation Gate" (end of week 3) and "Production Decision" (end of week 6). Each gate has a small set of must-pass tests and a second-tier set of recommended checks.
- Tolerances: we recommend a primary pass threshold of 95% accuracy on the intent classification evaluation set and <300ms median p95 latency for inference under the agreed pilot load.
- Acceptance tests: clear, automatable smoke tests (see tab "Smoke Tests" in the XLSX) plus a manual review checklist for stakeholder signoff.
- RACI: we've proposed owners for each test and an escalation path if thresholds fail.

Attachments: RDW-Novus-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (MAP + test matrix), novus-smoke-tests-2026-07.docx (test run steps + expected outputs).

Next steps: if this aligns with your expectations, can we lock the MAP tomorrow and schedule the Validation Gate demo for Thursday (23 Jul)? If you want to adjust metrics or owners, highlight in the XLSX.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Alan Jacobs <alan.jacobs@novushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <ops@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tolerances for the pilot (first pass)

Soojin —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Priya and I reviewed and had a few clarifying questions: 

1) The 95% accuracy target on the intent eval — is that micro-F1 or strict label match? We need to understand how any false positives will affect our downstream routing.
2) For the latency target, does the p95 include network time from our VPC to the Redwood Dedicated endpoint? Our infra team usually budgets for network variance.
3) If we fail Validation Gate, do we have an agreed remediation window or is it an immediate stop?

On owners: procurement wants a single doc we can attach to the SOW that summarizes acceptance criteria and signoff authorities. Can you export a one-page summary?

Thanks —
Alan
Alan Jacobs
Director, Digital Ops — Novus Health
alan.jacobs@novushealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alan Jacobs <alan.jacobs@novushealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <ops@novushealth.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tolerances for the pilot (first pass)

Alan —

Good questions. Short answers and proposed edits for the MAP: 

1) Accuracy metric: we'll use strict label match (exact intent label). The spreadsheet includes both exact match and micro-F1 columns; for the exit gate we'll evaluate exact match but record micro-F1 for diagnostic context.

2) Latency: the p95 in the MAP is server-side inference time (token generation + model overhead). We'll add a network buffer in the summary for procurement: recommend p95 (end-to-end) <= 350ms to accommodate typical VPC egress variability. We'll note this explicitly in the one-page SOW appendix.

3) Failure behavior: propose a 5-business-day remediation window after Validation Gate before escalation to the steering committee. If critical security or data integrity issues are discovered, Redwood will pause any further client-facing rollouts immediately and notify Novus within 12 hours.

Action items I'm adding to the MAP: owner column for the one-pager, explicit measurement method for each metric, and a short remediation timeline. I'm attaching the condensed one-pager (excerpt).

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tolerances for the pilot (first pass)

Hi all —

Quick note from CS and the runbook perspective: 

- The smoke-tests doc specifies deterministic prompts and pass/fail criteria; we'll run those in an automated harness during Validation Gate and include the raw logs in the Validation Gate packet.
- For manual acceptance, recommend a 3-person stakeholder panel (Ops, Product, Legal) for the Production Decision gate to avoid signoff stalls. I'll list names in the one-pager.
- On rollback: our proposed rollback trigger is any single severity-1 functional failure in production after cutover OR a sustained failure rate >5% on critical intents for 2 consecutive days. That will trigger the rollback playbook in the MAP.

I'll prep the stakeholder list and add it to the MAP one-pager before the Validation Gate.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tolerances for the pilot (first pass) — locking MAP and Validation Gate schedule

Alan / Priya / procurement team —

Thanks for the clarifying questions and the alignment. Per Marcus and Lauren's notes, we've updated the MAP and attached a clean one-page appendix suitable for SOW attachment. Summary of the agreed changes (edits highlighted in the XLSX):

- Acceptance metrics: exact-label match = 95% (Validation Gate), micro-F1 recorded as diagnostic. End-to-end p95 latency <= 350ms (includes network buffer).
- Gates & timing: Validation Gate on Thu, 23 Jul — automated smoke-run + stakeholder demo; Production Decision on Thu, 6 Aug (end of pilot).
- Failure and remediation: 5-business-day remediation window post-Validation Gate before steering escalation; immediate pause for critical security/data issues. Rollback trigger as Lauren described.
- Owners: Marcus (technical measurement & remediation), Lauren (stakeholder coordination & manual signoff), Soojin (commercial signoff & SOW appendix).

Next steps: I've uploaded the MAP one-pager and final MAP to the shared Drive link in the XLSX. Alan — if procurement confirms the one-pager language is acceptable, please reply-all with an explicit signoff line (e.g., "Novus accepts the MAP one-pager as SOW appendix") and we will proceed to schedule the Validation Gate run and send calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.
Soojin
